```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

# Output file index

All files are written to `results/mash/medianUMI1/lfc3/supp_subsets/outputs/` as paired `.csv` + `.xlsx`.

| File | Manuscript label | Rows | Definition |
|------|------------------|------|------------|
| `SX_full_response_eqtl_annotated`  | S18 | 39,097 rows              | Full annotated response eQTL table (all pre-filtered calls with specificity flags) |
| `subset_condition_specific`        | S19 | 523 unique loci          | Loci detected in exactly one (celltype x treatment) pair globally |
| `S_table1_anchored`                | S21 | many-to-many with Table 1 | Response eQTLs in cell types matched to Table 1 adverse events, with clinical context columns attached |
| `subset_within_celltype_drug_specific` | S22 | 1,391 unique loci    | Loci that are response eQTLs for exactly one drug within a given cell type |

`SX_full_response_eqtl_annotated` is the master table. `subset_condition_specific` and `subset_within_celltype_drug_specific` are row-filters of it. `S_table1_anchored` is an inner join of it with the Table 1 clinical crosswalk.

# Setup

## Libraries and paths

```{r setup-libraries}
library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, readr, stringr, tidyr, purrr
library(openxlsx)    # write.xlsx() — single-sheet XLSX files
library(knitr)       # kable() for HTML display tables
```

```{r setup-paths}
results_dir <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/results/mash/medianUMI1"
lfc3_dir    <- file.path(results_dir, "lfc3")
code_dir    <- "/project/gilad/geena/publication_clean/code/mash"
out_dir     <- file.path(lfc3_dir, "supp_subsets")
tsv_dir     <- file.path(out_dir, "outputs")

# Create output directories (safe to call multiple times)
dir.create(tsv_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
cat("Output directory:", tsv_dir, "\n")
```

## write_both helper

```{r helper-write-both}
# write_both: write a data frame as both CSV and single-sheet XLSX.

write_both <- function(df, name, dir = tsv_dir) {
  readr::write_csv(df, file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(as.data.frame(df),
                       file.path(dir, paste0(name, ".xlsx")),
                       overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("  wrote:", name, "(", nrow(df), "rows )\n")
}
```

# Load source data

```{r load-data}
# Source file: supp_table_response_eqtls.tsv
# 39,097 rows: all pre-filtered response eQTL calls, each row is a response eQTL x treatment x cell type combination
# Columns: gene, snp, gene_snp, celltype, treatment, beta_treat, sd_treat,
#          lfsr_treat, beta_control, sd_control, lfsr_control, fold_change
#
#   beta_treat and beta_control are posterior effect sizes in units of
#   inverse-normal logCPM per ALT allele copy (dosage 0/1/2 of ALT).
#   Sources: find_specific_eqtl_examples.R:378-385, .Rmd:435,
#            2_matrixeqtl_treatment.R:108 (rowMeans/2 = ALT freq)
#
# fold_change = abs(beta_treat) / abs(beta_control)
#   Source: post_mash_analysis_v2.Rmd line 1027
#
# Response eQTL definition:
#   (lfsr_treat < 0.05 OR lfsr_control < 0.05)
#   AND (fold_change >= 3 OR fold_change <= 1/3 OR sign_flip)
df_raw <- read_tsv(
  file.path(lfc3_dir, "supp_table_response_eqtls.tsv"),
  col_types = cols(
    gene         = col_character(),
    snp          = col_character(),
    gene_snp     = col_character(),
    celltype     = col_character(),
    treatment    = col_character(),
    beta_treat   = col_double(),
    sd_treat     = col_double(),
    lfsr_treat   = col_double(),
    beta_control = col_double(),
    sd_control   = col_double(),
    lfsr_control = col_double(),
    fold_change  = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat("Loaded:", nrow(df_raw), "rows,", ncol(df_raw), "columns\n")
```



```{r verify-derive-counts}
# Global: unique gene_snp pairs (2137 unique SNP-gene pairs across all treatments and cell types)
n_unique_loci <- n_distinct(df_raw$gene_snp)

# Per-drug unique response eQTLs
per_drug_loci <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(n_loci = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(treatment)

# How many drugs does a response eQTL show up for?
drug_per_locus <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(gene_snp) %>%
  summarise(n_drugs = n_distinct(treatment), .groups = "drop")

# Global drug-specific: gene_snp is a call in exactly one treatment
n_global_specific_loci <- sum(drug_per_locus$n_drugs == 1)

per_drug_global_specific <- df_raw %>%
  inner_join(drug_per_locus %>% filter(n_drugs == 1), by = "gene_snp") %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(n_loci = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(treatment)

# Within a cell type, how many drugs is an eQTL treatment responsive for?
wct_per_pair <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(gene_snp, celltype) %>%
  summarise(n_drugs_in_ct = n_distinct(treatment), .groups = "drop")

# Within-cell-type drug-specific: per (gene_snp, celltype), call for exactly one drug (1391 total)
n_within_ct_specific_loci <- df_raw %>%
  inner_join(wct_per_pair %>% filter(n_drugs_in_ct == 1), by = c("gene_snp", "celltype")) %>%
  pull(gene_snp) %>% n_distinct()

per_drug_within_ct <- df_raw %>%
  inner_join(wct_per_pair %>% filter(n_drugs_in_ct == 1), by = c("gene_snp", "celltype")) %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(n_loci = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(treatment)

# All-five-drug: response eQTL in all 5 treatments (any cell type) - 1097
n_all_five <- sum(drug_per_locus$n_drugs == 5)

# How many cell types is a response eQTL present in? (regardless of treatment)
ct_per_locus <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(gene_snp) %>%
  summarise(n_celltypes = n_distinct(celltype), .groups = "drop")
n_single_ct <- sum(ct_per_locus$n_celltypes == 1)

# All-celltype: response eQTL in all 21 cell types
n_all_ct <- sum(ct_per_locus$n_celltypes == 21)

# All-five-within-celltype: gene_snp hasat least 1 cell type where it is treatment-responsive for all 5 drugs
# Distinct from all_five_drug (which ignores cell type identity)
# TRUE/FALSE flag for this
all5_wct <- wct_per_pair %>%
  group_by(gene_snp) %>%
  summarise(all_five_within_celltype = any(n_drugs_in_ct == 5), .groups = "drop")
n_all5_within <- sum(all5_wct$all_five_within_celltype) # 921

# Condition-specific: gene_snp appears in exactly one (celltype × treatment) pair
cond_per_locus <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(gene_snp) %>%
  summarise(n_conditions = n_distinct(paste(celltype, treatment)), .groups = "drop")
n_condition_specific <- sum(cond_per_locus$n_conditions == 1) # 523
```



# Specificity flag computation

All flags computed once here, then joined to the master table. Separating
computation from joining makes each flag independently auditable.

```{r compute-flags-per-locus}
# Per-gene_snp flags
locus_flags <- drug_per_locus %>%
  # n_drugs: number of distinct treatments a gene_snp is a call in (any cell type)
  left_join(ct_per_locus,   by = "gene_snp") %>%
  # n_celltypes: distinct cell types across all treatments
  left_join(cond_per_locus, by = "gene_snp") %>%
  # n_conditions: distinct (celltype × treatment) pairs
  # Note: all_five_within_celltype is NOT joined here — it is a per-(gene_snp, celltype)
  # property (TRUE when n_drugs_in_ct == 5) and lives in wct_flags instead.
  mutate(
    # single_celltype: response eQTL in only one cell type (regardless of treatment)
    single_celltype      = (n_celltypes == 1),
    # all_celltype: response eQTL in all 21 mapped cell types (any treatment)
    all_celltype         = (n_celltypes == 21),
    # all_five_drug: response eQTL in all 5 treatments (any cell type)
    all_five_drug        = (n_drugs == 5),
    # global_drug_specific: response eQTL in exactly one treatment globally.
    # Complementary end of the specificity spectrum from all_five_drug.
    global_drug_specific = (n_drugs == 1),
    # condition_specific: response eQTL in exactly one (celltype × treatment) pair.
    # Most granular specificity; corresponds to manuscript S13.
    condition_specific   = (n_conditions == 1)
  )

# global_specific_drug: treatment-specific across the whole dataset
# Record which drug it is global treatment-specific for,NA when global_drug_specific == FALSE.
global_drug_label <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(gene_snp) %>%
  summarise(
    global_specific_drug = if_else(
      n_distinct(treatment) == 1,
      first(treatment),
      NA_character_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

locus_flags <- locus_flags %>%
  left_join(global_drug_label, by = "gene_snp")
```

```{r compute-flags-per-locus-celltype}
# Per-(gene_snp, celltype) flags

# within_celltype_drug_specific: within a given cell type, this locus is a response eQTL for exactly one drug.
# Note: same locus can be ct-specific to Cri in retina and ct-specific to Lor in neurons simultaneously
# List which drug it is specific to for that cell type
wct_flags <- wct_per_pair %>%
  mutate(
    # all_five_within_celltype: TRUE only when THIS cell type has all 5 drugs for this locus.
    # Per-(gene_snp, celltype) flag — not a locus-level flag. A row where n_drugs_in_ct < 5
    # gets FALSE even if the locus qualifies in another cell type.
    all_five_within_celltype   = (n_drugs_in_ct == 5),
    within_celltype_drug_specific = (n_drugs_in_ct == 1)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_raw %>%
      group_by(gene_snp, celltype) %>%
      summarise(
        within_ct_specific_drug = if_else(
          n_distinct(treatment) == 1, first(treatment), NA_character_
        ),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("gene_snp", "celltype")
  )
```


# S18 — Full annotated response eQTL table

```{r build-s10-annotated}
# Parse allele fields from SNP ID
# SNP format: chr:pos:REF_ALT (e.g., "8:41245044:C_T")
# Parsing logic mirrors find_specific_eqtl_examples.R lines 378-385 exactly.
# Group 1 = chromosome, 2 = position, 3 = REF allele, 4 = ALT allele
snp_parsed <- str_match(
  df_raw$snp,
  "^([^:]+):([0-9]+):([A-Za-z]+)_([A-Za-z]+)$"
)
n_parse_fail <- sum(is.na(snp_parsed[, 1]))
if (n_parse_fail > 0) {
  warning(n_parse_fail, " SNP IDs did not match expected chr:pos:REF_ALT format.")
}

# Full annotated response eQTL table

df_annotated <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    # Parsed allele fields
    chr        = snp_parsed[, 2],
    pos        = as.integer(snp_parsed[, 3]),
    ref_allele = snp_parsed[, 4],
    alt_allele = snp_parsed[, 5],

    # Direction of effect: "+" = more expression per additional ALT copy (i.e. is beta positive or negative)
    direction_treat   = if_else(beta_treat   >= 0, "+", "-"),
    direction_control = if_else(beta_control >= 0, "+", "-"),

    # sign_flip: drug inverts the direction of the genotype effect (if beta in control != beta in treatment)
    sign_flip = (sign(beta_treat) != sign(beta_control)),

    # Significance flags (lfsr < 0.05 = significant by mashr convention)
    sig_treat      = (lfsr_treat   < 0.05),
    sig_control    = (lfsr_control < 0.05),
    sig_both       = (lfsr_treat   < 0.05 & lfsr_control < 0.05),
    sig_treat_only = (lfsr_treat   < 0.05 & lfsr_control >= 0.05), # sig_treat_only: detectable only under treatment
    sig_control_only = (lfsr_control   < 0.05 & lfsr_treat >= 0.05),

    # abs_delta_beta: magnitude of the treated-vs-control effect change.
    # Primary continuous ranking criterion for candidate selection.
    abs_delta_beta = abs(beta_treat - beta_control)
  ) %>%
  # Join per-locus specificity flags
  left_join(locus_flags, by = "gene_snp") %>%
  # Join per-(locus, celltype) flags
  left_join(
    wct_flags %>% dplyr::select(gene_snp, celltype,
                         all_five_within_celltype,
                         within_celltype_drug_specific, within_ct_specific_drug,
                         n_drugs_in_ct),
    by = c("gene_snp", "celltype")
  )

# Confirm no row duplication from joins (both flag tables are 1:1 with df_raw keys)
stopifnot(
  "Row count changed after join — check for duplicates in flag tables" =
    nrow(df_annotated) == nrow(df_raw)
)

cat("Full response eQTL table annotated:", nrow(df_annotated), "rows,", ncol(df_annotated), "columns\n")
write_both(df_annotated, "SX_full_response_eqtl_annotated")
```


# S22 — Within-cell-type drug-specific loci

Rows where the gene-SNP pair is a response eQTL for exactly one drug **in this cell type**.
An eQTL can appear in multiple rows if it is ct-specific to different drugs in different cell types.

```{r subset-within-ct-drug-specific}
subset_wct <- df_annotated %>%
  filter(within_celltype_drug_specific) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_delta_beta), desc(fold_change))

write_both(subset_wct, "subset_within_celltype_drug_specific")

kable(
  subset_wct %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(n_loci = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop"),
  caption = sprintf("Within-ct drug-specific loci by drug (%d total unique)", n_within_ct_specific_loci)
)
```


# S19 — Condition-specific loci

Response eQTLs detected in exactly one (celltype × treatment) condition globally.

```{r subset-condition-specific}
subset_cond <- df_annotated %>%
  filter(condition_specific) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_delta_beta), desc(fold_change))

write_both(subset_cond, "subset_condition_specific")

kable(
  subset_cond %>%
    group_by(treatment) %>%
    summarise(n_loci = n_distinct(gene_snp), .groups = "drop"),
  caption = sprintf("Condition-specific loci by drug (%d total)", n_condition_specific)
)
```


# S21 — Table 1-anchored supplementary table

Joins the master annotated table with Table 1 (drug × adverse event × cell type), restricted to the cell types and drugs in the response eQTLs.
Each row in the output is a response eQTL with its Table 1 clinical context: drug generation, additional targets, adverse event, and reported incidence.

The join is on (treatment == drug_abbr, celltype == eqtl_celltype):

- `drug_abbr`: full drug name mapped to 3-letter code (Crizotinib → Cri, etc.)
- `reqtl_celltype`: readable Table 1 cell type name mapped to S10 compact name
  (e.g., "Bronchiolar/alveolar epithelial cells" → "Bronchiolar_and_alveolar_epithelial_cells")

Cell types not in S10 (e.g., Stellate cells, Skeletal muscle cells, Ductal cells)
are excluded naturally by the inner join — only rows with a confirmed S10 cell type
will appear in the output.

```{r table1-load}
# Load Table 1 long-format CSV
# Written by this session at: code/mash/Table1_adverse_events_long.csv
table1_long <- read_csv(
  file.path(code_dir, "Table1_adverse_events_long.csv"),
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

cat("Table1 loaded:", nrow(table1_long), "rows\n")
```

```{r table1-add-drug-abbr}
# Map full drug names to 3-letter treatment codes used in eQTL data.
# These codes are the canonical abbreviations throughout the manuscript.
drug_abbr_map <- c(
  "Alectinib"   = "Ale",
  "Brigatinib"  = "Bri",
  "Ceritinib"   = "Cer",
  "Crizotinib"  = "Cri",
  "Lorlatinib"  = "Lor"
)

table1_long <- table1_long %>%
  mutate(drug_abbr = drug_abbr_map[Drug])

# Verify all drugs mapped
unmapped_drugs <- table1_long %>%
  filter(is.na(drug_abbr)) %>%
  pull(Drug) %>%
  unique()
if (length(unmapped_drugs) > 0) {
  warning("Unmapped drug names in Table1: ", paste(unmapped_drugs, collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r table1-add-s10-celltype}
# Map Table 1 readable cell type names to S10 compact names.
# Most are a direct substitution of spaces with underscores; exceptions:
#   "Bronchiolar/alveolar epithelial cells" → "Bronchiolar_and_alveolar_epithelial_cells"
#     (the "/" becomes "_and_", matching the S10 vocabulary)
#   "Retinal progenitors/Muller glia" → "Retinal_progenitors_and_Muller_glia"
#     (same pattern — the "/" becomes "_and_")
#   "Vascular endothelial cells" → "Vascular_endothelial_cells"
#     (kept as-is with underscores; this is the exact S10 name)
#   "Neuronal IPC" → "Neuronal_IPC"
#     (confirmed in ae_celltype_map.csv for Lor CNS_effects)
#   "ENS glia" → "ENS_glia"
#     (confirmed in ae_celltype_map.csv for Cer GI_toxicity)
#   "Oligo" → excluded (oligodendrocytes not in S10; Table1 eQTL_mapped=No)
# Cell types not present in this map (Stellate cells, Ductal cells, etc.)
# will have reqtl_celltype=NA and be dropped by the inner join below.

table1_to_response <- tribble(
  ~table1_celltype,                          ~reqtl_celltype,
  "Hepatoblasts",                            "Hepatoblasts",
  "Bronchiolar/alveolar epithelial cells",   "Bronchiolar_and_alveolar_epithelial_cells",
  "Ciliated epithelial cells",               "Ciliated_epithelial_cells",
  "Stromal cells",                           "Stromal_cells",
  "Cardiac mesoderm cells",                  "Cardiac_mesoderm_cells",
  "Metanephric cells",                       "Metanephric_cells",
  "Retinal neurons",                         "Retinal_neurons",
  "Retinal pigment cells",                   "Retinal_pigment_cells",
  "Retinal progenitors/Muller glia",         "Retinal_progenitors_and_Muller_glia",
  "Vascular endothelial cells",              "Vascular_endothelial_cells",
  "ENS glia",                                "ENS_glia",
  "Goblet cells",                            "Goblet_cells",
  "Epicardial fat cells",                    "Epicardial_fat_cells",
  "Squamous epithelial cells",               "Squamous_epithelial_cells",
  "Glioblast",                               "Glioblast",
  "Neuroblast",                              "Neuroblast",
  "Neuron",                                  "Neuron",
  "Neuronal IPC",                            "Neuronal_IPC",
  "Radial glia",                             "Radial_glia"
  # Skeletal muscle cells: not in S10 — will be dropped by inner join
  # Satellite cells: not in S10
  # Stellate cells: not in S10
  # Ductal cells / Acinar cells: not in S10
  # Lens fibre cells: not in S10
  # Cardiomyocytes / Endocardial cells: not in S10
  # Islet endocrine cells: not in S10
  # Smooth cells / Smooth muscle cells: not in S10
  # Myeloid cells: not in S10
  # Oligo: not in S10
)

table1_long <- table1_long %>%
  left_join(table1_to_response, by = c("Cell_type" = "table1_celltype"))

# Report which Table1 cell types have no S10 mapping
no_mapping <- table1_long %>%
  filter(is.na(reqtl_celltype)) %>%
  pull(Cell_type) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()
cat("Table1 cell types without eQTL mapping (will be dropped by join):\n")
cat(paste("  -", no_mapping, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

```{r table1-anchored-join}
# eQTL cell types (used to verify Table1 mappings are in the S10 vocabulary)
eqtl_celltypes <- sort(unique(df_raw$celltype))

# Prepare Table1 metadata columns to carry into the join.
# Keep both the Table1 AE description (full, informative) and a clean
# identifier for matching. Also verify that all eqtl_celltypes in Table1
# (with eQTL_mapped=Yes) are indeed present in the S10 vocabulary.
table1_meta <- table1_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(reqtl_celltype)) %>%
  # Verify: reqtl_celltype must be a real S10 cell type
  mutate(
    s10_confirmed = reqtl_celltype %in% eqtl_celltypes
  )

not_in_eqtl <- table1_meta %>%
  filter(!s10_confirmed) %>%
  dplyr::select(Drug, Adverse_event, Cell_type, reqtl_celltype) %>%
  distinct()
if (nrow(not_in_eqtl) > 0) {
  warning("The following eqtl_celltype values are not in the response eQTL vocabulary:\n",
          paste(capture.output(print(not_in_eqtl)), collapse = "\n"))
}

# Build Table1 metadata frame for joining: one row per (drug_abbr, reqtl_celltype, AE)
table1_meta_clean <- table1_meta %>%
  filter(s10_confirmed) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    drug_abbr,
    Drug_fullname    = Drug,
    Generation       = Generation,
    Additional_non_ALK_targets = Additional_non_ALK_targets,
    Adverse_event_table1       = Adverse_event,
    Most_common_reaction       = Most_common_reaction_asterisk,
    Reported_incidence         = Reported_incidence,
    Cell_type_table1           = Cell_type,
    reqtl_celltype
  )

# Inner join: only loci in cell types AND drugs covered by Table 1
# Many-to-many: a locus in Hepatoblasts × Lor appears under Hepatotoxicity,
# Hyperlipidemia, AND Hyperglycemia (all Table1 AEs for Lor that map to Hepatoblasts)
S_table1_anchored <- df_annotated %>%
  inner_join(
    table1_meta_clean,
    by = c("treatment" = "drug_abbr", "celltype" = "reqtl_celltype"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  )

# Summary counts for display
counts_table1 <- S_table1_anchored %>%
  group_by(treatment, Adverse_event_table1) %>%
  summarise(
    n_loci = n_distinct(gene_snp),
    n_rows = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("S_table1_anchored:", nrow(S_table1_anchored), "rows,",
    n_distinct(S_table1_anchored$gene_snp), "unique loci\n")

write_both(S_table1_anchored, "S_table1_anchored")

kable(
  counts_table1,
  caption = sprintf(
    "S_table1_anchored: loci per (drug, Table1 AE) (%d rows, %d unique loci)",
    nrow(S_table1_anchored), n_distinct(S_table1_anchored$gene_snp)
  )
)
```
